findings.description: Negative with a clean outcome: `HTTP/1.1 417 Expectation Failed`, `Content-Length: 0`, `Connection: close`, `eof` at 0.000 s, nothing after it and no upstream contact. All six value shapes (case, unknown token, padded, duplicate, empty, plus chunked) collapse to the identical 417, so the value is never inspected. The socket dies with the response, so the unconsumed body is discarded rather than re-parsed.
findings.title: `Expect: 100-continue` is refused with a bare 417 that closes the socket, so the body after it is dead but nothing is desynced

limitations: All RCE in this corpus is RCE on the upstream host
